snippet.title: Under Canopies | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Under Canopies
Forget the stress of survival. In this cozy open-world sim, you don't fight nature, you join it. Build your dream cabin piece by piece, cook complex meals with crops you watered yourself, and fill your photo album with rare wildlife. A serene experience where the only enemy is inefficiency.
